description: This file provides utility functions for file operations such as creating directories, opening, reading, writing, touching files, and changing permissions, specifically tailored for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes wrappers that apply configuration-based permissions and cache management.

methods.name: sugar_mkdir
methods.description: Create a directory with configurable permissions, applying ownership and group settings if specified, and logging errors if creation fails.

methods.name: sugar_fopen
methods.description: Open a file, creating it if it doesn't exist, with configurable permission settings.

methods.name: sugar_fclose
methods.description: Close a file handle and clear it from cache if it is a PHP file.

methods.name: sugar_file_put_contents
methods.description: Write data to a file with permission settings, creating the file if necessary, and clearing cache if PHP file.

methods.name: sugar_file_put_contents_atomic
methods.description: Perform an atomic write to a file, creating a temporary file and renaming it, with configurable permissions.

methods.name: sugar_file_get_contents
methods.description: Read contents from a file, creating it if missing, with error logging.

methods.name: sugar_touch
methods.description: Set access and modification times on a file, creating it if necessary, with configurable permissions.

methods.name: sugar_chmod
methods.description: Change file permission mode, respecting configuration defaults and skipping on Windows.

methods.name: sugar_chown
methods.description: Change file owner, respecting configuration defaults and skipping on Windows.

methods.name: sugar_chgrp
methods.description: Change file group, respecting configuration defaults and skipping on Windows.

methods.name: get_mode
methods.description: Retrieve permission mode from configuration or use given default.

methods.name: sugar_cached
methods.description: Generate cache filename path within configured cache directory.
